title: QA & Quality Engineer
description: End-to-end quality engineering: testing principles, test pyramid, boundary analysis, exploratory charters, API testing with Postman, Playwright web automation, k6 load testing, and CI/CD orchestration.

phases.title: QA Foundations & Manual Mastery
phases.focus: Testing Principles, Test Pyramid, Black/White-Box Design, Exploratory Testing & Bug Reporting

phases.title: Test Automation Core
phases.focus: Postman API Testing, Playwright E2E, Page Object Model, CI/CD Pipelines & Test Data Management

phases.title: Specialized & Non-Functional Testing
phases.focus: Appium Mobile Testing, k6 Performance Testing, Security/OWASP, a11y & Pact Contracts

phases.title: Quality Engineering Strategy
phases.focus: Shift-Left QA Strategy, Defect Escape Rate, and Full-Stack Framework Capstone

nodes.title: QA Foundations & Testing Principles
nodes.subtitle: 7 testing principles, verification vs validation, bug lifecycle, defect severity vs priority
learning_objectives: Apply the 7 core testing principles (e.g. testing shows presence of defects, pesticide paradox)
Classify reported bugs accurately by severity (impact) and priority (urgency)
feynman_prompts: Explain the difference between verification ('are we building the product right?') and validation ('are we building the right product?').
key_misconceptions: Believing that exhaustive testing is possible for non-trivial software

nodes.title: The Test Pyramid & Test Levels
nodes.subtitle: Unit, integration, component, API, E2E testing, manual vs automated balance, test coverage
learning_objectives: Structure test suites in accordance with the Test Pyramid to ensure speed and reliability
Determine when a test should be written at the unit, API, or UI level
feynman_prompts: Why does an inverted testing pyramid ('ice cream cone') lead to slow, brittle test suites?
key_misconceptions: Relying exclusively on end-to-end UI tests to catch low-level calculation bugs

nodes.title: Black-Box & White-Box Test Design Techniques
nodes.subtitle: Equivalence partitioning, boundary value analysis (BVA), decision tables, state transition testing
learning_objectives: Design optimal test cases using 2-point and 3-point Boundary Value Analysis
Construct decision tables to test complex combinations of business rules
feynman_prompts: Why is Boundary Value Analysis more likely to uncover bugs than testing arbitrary middle values?
key_misconceptions: Writing dozens of redundant test cases covering the exact same equivalence partition

nodes.title: Exploratory Testing & Heuristic Charters
nodes.subtitle: Session-based testing, bug hunting charters, SFDIPOT heuristic, tour heuristics
learning_objectives: Execute time-boxed exploratory testing sessions using defined mission charters
Apply James Bach's SFDIPOT heuristic to systematically explore system dimensions
feynman_prompts: How does structured exploratory testing differ from random, aimless 'ad-hoc' testing?
key_misconceptions: Treating exploratory testing as unplanned guessing without notes or charters

nodes.title: High-Impact Bug Reporting & Triage
nodes.subtitle: Reproduction steps, expected vs actual, logs, network traces, isolation, triage meetings
learning_objectives: Author crystal-clear, minimal reproduction steps with attached network traces and logs
Isolate edge cases to identify the exact minimal triggering condition
feynman_prompts: What makes a bug report easy for an engineer to reproduce and fix immediately?
key_misconceptions: Filing vague bug reports like 'Checkout doesn't work' without device, logs, or steps

nodes.title: API Testing with Postman & Newman
nodes.subtitle: HTTP methods, status codes, assertion scripts, collections, environment variables, Newman CLI
learning_objectives: Build automated API test suites validating JSON schemas, status codes, and response times
Execute Postman collections headlessly in CI pipelines using Newman
feynman_prompts: Why is API testing faster and more reliable than UI-based end-to-end testing?
key_misconceptions: Validating only HTTP status 200 without asserting response payload schemas and business values

nodes.title: Web Automation with Playwright
nodes.subtitle: Locators, auto-waiting, fixtures, page object model (POM), headless execution, trace viewer
learning_objectives: Write resilient web end-to-end test cases using modern Playwright locators
Debug flaky tests using the Playwright Trace Viewer and recorded network steps
feynman_prompts: Why are Playwright's role-based locators and auto-waiting superior to hardcoded sleep delays?
key_misconceptions: Sprinkling hardcoded `time.sleep(5000)` calls throughout test scripts to fix timing flakiness

nodes.title: Test Automation Architecture & Page Object Model
nodes.subtitle: Page Object Model (POM), Screenplay pattern, DRY assertions, clean abstraction layers
learning_objectives: Implement the Page Object Model to cleanly decouple test logic from UI selectors
Maintain modular, scalable automation frameworks that resist UI redesign breakage
feynman_prompts: How does Page Object Model prevent updating hundreds of tests when a button selector changes?
key_misconceptions: Writing raw element selectors and click actions directly inside test verification functions

nodes.title: Continuous Testing & CI/CD Orchestration
nodes.subtitle: GitHub Actions, test parallelization, sharding, test reporting, handling flaky tests
learning_objectives: Integrate automated test execution into GitHub Actions pull request workflows
Configure test sharding and parallel execution to reduce CI feedback time below 10 minutes
feynman_prompts: What strategies prevent flaky tests from blocking pull request merges in CI?
key_misconceptions: Ignoring intermittent CI test failures as 'just flakiness' rather than investigating root causes

nodes.title: Test Data Management, Mocking & Virtualization
nodes.subtitle: Faker, test databases, database seeding, WireMock, mocking third-party APIs, isolation
learning_objectives: Seed isolated test database states before executing test suites
Mock third-party payment gateways and external APIs using WireMock or MSW
feynman_prompts: Why should tests generate their own dynamic test data rather than relying on shared static accounts?
key_misconceptions: Sharing a single static test user across concurrent automated test runs

nodes.title: Mobile App Testing Fundamentals & Appium
nodes.subtitle: Mobile gestures, device fragmentation, Appium architecture, testing iOS & Android builds
learning_objectives: Automate mobile UI test flows on real and virtual devices using Appium
Test platform-specific mobile edge cases (network drops, backgrounding, push notifications)
feynman_prompts: How do mobile automation timing challenges differ from web browser automation?
key_misconceptions: Testing mobile apps exclusively in desktop browser emulators instead of real mobile runtimes

nodes.title: Performance & Load Testing with k6
nodes.subtitle: Virtual users (VUs), latency percentiles (p95, p99), stress testing, spike testing, soak testing
learning_objectives: Write load testing scripts simulating thousands of concurrent users in k6
Analyze p95 and p99 latency thresholds under peak load conditions
feynman_prompts: Why are average response times misleading when evaluating system performance under load?
key_misconceptions: Running load tests against production databases without rate limits or cleanup procedures

nodes.title: Security Testing Basics (OWASP Top 10)
nodes.subtitle: SQL injection, XSS, CSRF, auth bypass, automated security scanning (ZAP, Snyk)
learning_objectives: Test endpoints for common vulnerabilities like SQL injection, IDOR, and XSS
Integrate OWASP ZAP automated dynamic vulnerability scanning into staging pipelines
feynman_prompts: What is Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR) and how do you test for it?
key_misconceptions: Assuming that client-side form validation provides adequate application security

nodes.title: Automated & Manual Accessibility Testing (a11y)
nodes.subtitle: Axe-core, screen readers (NVDA, VoiceOver), color contrast, keyboard tab navigation
learning_objectives: Integrate axe-core automated accessibility audits into Playwright E2E suites
Perform manual screen reader audits verifying semantic labels and focus management
feynman_prompts: Why can automated a11y tools like axe-core catch only ~30-40% of accessibility issues?
key_misconceptions: Assuming passing automated axe checks means an application is fully accessible

nodes.title: Contract Testing for Microservices (Pact)
nodes.subtitle: Consumer-driven contract testing, Pact framework, broker verification, avoiding E2E hell
learning_objectives: Implement consumer-driven contracts using Pact to ensure API compatibility across teams
Prevent breaking API schema changes in microservices without heavy integration environments
feynman_prompts: How does contract testing provide confidence without spinning up dozens of dependent microservices?
key_misconceptions: Deploying breaking API changes to staging and relying on slow E2E tests to detect them

nodes.title: Resilience & Chaos Testing Fundamentals
nodes.subtitle: Fault injection, network latency injection, Chaos Mesh, graceful degradation testing
learning_objectives: Simulate infrastructure failures (dropped packets, database latency) to test graceful recovery
Verify that the frontend displays helpful fallback states when downstream services fail
feynman_prompts: Why is testing for system failure resilience just as important as testing happy paths?
key_misconceptions: Assuming redundant servers guarantee zero downtime without actively testing failovers

nodes.title: QA Strategy, Metrics & Quality Engineering Leadership
nodes.subtitle: Shift-left testing, defect escape rate, mean time to detect (MTTD), establishing quality culture
learning_objectives: Lead an engineering organization from manual gatekeeping to proactive Quality Engineering
Track and reduce Defect Escape Rate while accelerating deployment velocity
feynman_prompts: Why is shifting testing 'left' into development cheaper than finding bugs in QA staging?
key_misconceptions: Viewing QA as an isolated department responsible for all bugs rather than an engineering-wide quality culture

nodes.title: Full-Stack Test Automation Framework Capstone
nodes.subtitle: Architecting an enterprise-grade framework: CI, parallel execution, reporting, Slack alerts
learning_objectives: Architect and deploy an enterprise test framework incorporating API, E2E, reporting, and CI
Implement auto-healing locators and automated test failure diagnostics with Slack alerts
feynman_prompts: What makes an automated test suite maintainable over a multi-year enterprise lifecycle?
key_misconceptions: Building overly complex, custom in-house automation engines instead of standard industry tools
